title: Uniqueness of a first hitting time
statement: Let $M$ be a multi-tape Turing machine and let $F$ be a set of states. Suppose a run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time before $t$, and the state of $b$ belongs to $F$. Suppose also that the run from $a$ reaches $b'$ after $t'$ steps, avoids $F$ at every time before $t'$, and the state of $b'$ belongs to $F$. Then $t=t'$.
hypotheses_covered: The run from $a$ reaches $b$ after $t$ steps
The state at every time before $t$ is outside $F$
The run from $a$ reaches $b'$ after $t'$ steps
The state at every time before $t'$ is outside $F$
